definitions.explanation: An exclamation said when raising glasses together; the act of making a toast.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{乾杯|かんぱい}！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone said 'Cheers!' and clinked glasses together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}って→祝う：01881_iwau⟧{乾杯|かんぱい}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's toast to the new year.

examples.japanese: {乾杯|かんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦いただけますか→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}って→祝う：01881_iwau⟧{乾杯|かんぱい}！

notes:
{乾杯|かんぱい} literally means 'dry cup' (drinking until the cup is empty).

Common expressions:
- {乾杯|かんぱい}！ (Cheers! - exclamation)
- {乾杯|かんぱい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a toast)
- {乾杯|かんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to lead the toast)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乾杯|かんぱい}！ (Cheers to ~!)

Cultural note:
- In Japanese drinking culture, the {乾杯|かんぱい} marks the official start of drinking
- Often led by a senior person or guest of honor
- It's polite to wait for the {乾杯|かんぱい} before drinking

Alternatives:
- ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧！ (Good work! - casual work-related toast)
